decisions.statement: A page is judged working, stale or undetermined.
A page is working where a process acts under its agent id or its seat has not seen it return.
A page is stale where its seat's subagent-presence log says its take-down was dropped.
A page is stale where no process at all carries its seat's agent id.
A page is stale where it was stopped from the agents panel.
The stop beside each page is read off disk here and handed to the census.
No stop makes a page removable that a live process acts under.
A page is stale where the transcript that dispatched it saw it start and return.
A subagent one subagent dispatched is seen that way as a seat's own is.
A fold is read for that though whatever it folds has itself returned.
A page is stale where its last record came before its seat's client started.
A page neither working nor stale is undetermined.
A compacted transcript names no agent id and leaves every judgement as it was.
A subagent the running reading does not name is not thereby ended.
No page's age is read.
The report names each page's seat, its agent id, what answers for it and why.
A removal is landed by this command rather than drafted.
A run naming nothing writes nothing.
A page goes only where the run was told to remove and the census judged that page stale.
A page taken away goes through the change taking a file of any kind away.
That change takes a page away with every file that page claims.
What a page has beside it moves onto that page's seat before the page goes.
A page whose seat the index has no page for and that has nothing waiting still goes.
The report names what moved before it names what went.
The landing a stale page goes through is handed in.
No page judged working or undetermined is ever removed.
The census is reported whether or not the run was told to remove.
A word this command takes no flag for refuses the whole run.
A run told to remove where nothing is stale says so and writes nothing.
Each seat's transcript is read for the subagents that seat has not seen return.
The seats read are the seats the index names rather than the seats the pages name.
A seat every page of whose subagents has gone is read as any other seat is.
The report names each subagent a transcript names as at work that has no page.
No subagent named that way is thereby removed or written.
A transcript entry naming no agent id is dropped rather than carried as an empty name.
An id both readings name is running rather than ended.
No transcript reading makes a page removable.
A transcript that will not open leaves the census the other evidence reached.
A seat whose reading throws costs that seat alone rather than the whole run.
A seat's running reading and its ended reading are each their own try.
Each seat's client is read for the subagents that client started after.
A seat stating no client leaves its subagents judged on the other evidence.
That reading is a try of its own like the two beside it.
The commit says why each page went on a line for that page.
A page removed is forgotten by every reader of that page.
A subagent taken away has the readings its seat kept for it dropped.
Those readings are dropped only after the removal landed.
A seat is asked once for every page of its own that went.
A page whose seat the index has no page for drops no reading.
The report names how many readings each seat keeps no longer.
A run told not to remove drops no reading.
A landing that refused leaves the census reported and the pages where the pages are.
A run that refused names in its refusal what it had moved onto a seat.
A move that threw part way refuses the run and names what moved before it threw.
A stale page goes whether or not a subagent left edits waiting beside it.
A stale page whose seat the index has no page for is left where it is while edits wait beside it.
The report names each page left that way and says why that page was left.
Why a page is left that way is read from the module the take-down reads it from.
A run that refused after the landing committed names that commit.

definition: the command judging every subagent page on disk and taking the stale ones away when told
